name: Offline Text to Speech
tagline: Give your computer a voice — offline text-to-speech that serves every app, no key, no cloud.
description:
This is a voice other apps can use. Install it, keep it in your Providers folder, and assign it to Text → speech in Settings → AI models. From then on, every app that asks GifOS to speak — Reader, games, anything that talks — is answered by this app, entirely on your device.

The voice is eSpeak, the classic compact robotic kind, packed inside this app — engine, dictionary and English (US) voice. Copy the file anywhere and the voice goes with it; it works on a plane, in a basement, anywhere. It never needs the network.

Seven voice variants respond to the familiar names apps already use (nova, shimmer, fable, echo, onyx, alloy, whisper). It is not a natural-sounding voice — it is the honest, robotic, instant kind that never bills you and never hears you.
